definitions.explanation: A designated area where smoking is permitted, often found in public spaces, offices, and transportation facilities.

examples.japanese: {喫煙所|きつえんじょ}はどこですか。
この{建物|たてもの}には{喫煙所|きつえんじょ}がない。
examples.english: This building doesn't have a smoking area.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{喫煙所|きつえんじょ}は{撤去|てっきょ}された。
examples.english: The smoking area at the station was removed.

notes:
FORMATION:
{喫煙|きつえん} (smoking) + {所|じょ} (place)

RELATED TERMS:
・{喫煙室|きつえんしつ} - smoking room (enclosed)
・{喫煙席|きつえんせき} - smoking seat/section
・{禁煙|きんえん} - no smoking
・{分煙|ぶんえん} - separation of smoking/non-smoking areas

COLLOCATIONS:
・{喫煙所|きつえんじょ}を{探|さが}す - to look for a smoking area
・{喫煙所|きつえんじょ}で{吸|す}う - to smoke in the smoking area

CULTURAL NOTE:
Smoking regulations in Japan have become stricter. Many public places now require smoking in designated areas only, and some municipalities have banned street smoking entirely.
